notes.content:

You can use the command !task to add a new task and it will show above your avatar.

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content:
I made some changes based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Fix for "Animals walk on the bottom" option not being saved
[*] Changed some Japanese texts and fixed some English typos
[*] Changed the position for new carts, before they would be sent to the end of the line. Now it will be unlocked next to the market sign and then try to find a place close to it. If there's no room, it will be sent to the end of the line, next to the last cart.
[*] For some people playing with 2 monitors, the game was not showing after launch.
You can try the shortcut ALT + ENTER to toggle fullscreen mode and see if it helps but I made some changes in the code to avoid that (I hope so :P).
In case you experience anything like this, let me know in the forum!

[/list]

Thank you all for playing and I will keep adding your feedback :)

notes.title: Patch - Camera movement
notes.content:
Some people mentioned that it was not obvious that you could move the camera, so I added arrow buttons in the menu to do it.

You can also use the keyboard shortcuts:
-A or Arrow left: Move camera to the left
-D or Arrow right: Move camera to the right
-Q: will place the camera on the first cart
-W: will place the camera on the cart that is in the middle
-E: will place the camera on the last cart

There's also an option in Settings -> Gameplay to sort carts based on the current client's order. Enable this option to place the carts that produce the wanted items for the current client in the first slots. This way you won't even have to move the camera to find the carts.
